targets.title: Emotions evoked by viewing pictures may affect temporal aspects of visual processing.
targets.evidence_quote: We first investigated whether the results from the Kobayashi and Ichikawa (2016) study could be replicated.
targets.outcome_quote: While attempting to replicate their results, we found the opposite results—that is, images with safe impressions were detected with higher accuracy than those with dangerous impressions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The direct attempt reversed the original finding; subsequent experiments attribute apparent temporal resolution to color rather than emotional danger. The authors reject the original emotional interpretation overall.
